title: Flint Beacon + Relay Evolution — informed by ludoSpring sovereignty
insight: northGate already solved the relay pattern: tissue proxy on eastGate bridges ANY browser to northGate RTX 5090. This same pattern scales to ALL gates.

ludoSpring_teaches.tissue_proxy: CORS bridge (π:5820) that relays HTTP from any LAN device to northGate. This IS the relay pattern.
ludoSpring_teaches.toadStool_dispatch: Workload TOML files describe what to run, where. toadStool routes to the right gate. This IS beacon discovery.
ludoSpring_teaches.a_life_tick: 1 Hz game entities making autonomous decisions via GPU inference. This IS what Gaia does — she THINKS on the GPU.
ludoSpring_teaches.composition: 12 NUCLEUS nodes composed via capability graph. No hardcoded names. This IS the membrane cascade pattern.
ludoSpring_teaches.kenshi_reborn: The world lives autonomously. NPCs make real decisions. The GPU is the world's BRAIN, not just its renderer.

flint_beacon.how: membrane gate.status already does this — extend with GPU capability announcements
flint_beacon.pattern: toadStool workload discovery → any gate can find which gate handles which task
flint_beacon.sporeGate_role: Flint pineapple — sub-bench beacon that relays biomeGate capabilities once plugged in
